about: Every staff tool, described once. tools/sync-partials.py writes the cards into /admin/ between <!-- @tools:admin --> markers; admin.js shows each person only the groups their role reaches. 'lowest' is the lowest role that may use the tool (coach, committee or admin); 'group' sets its section; 'count' adds a waiting-count badge (id admin-count-<count>). Order here is the order on the pages.

groups.name: Committee tools
groups.more: More committee tools are on the way.
